The NFC repository reviews the 22 upstream active skills and adopts/modifies
the 18 selected workflows recorded in
[`agent-skill-inventory.md`](../../docs/governance/agent-skill-inventory.md).
Two upstream-active workflows are deferred and two are excluded. Upstream
deprecated, in-progress, personal, and miscellaneous skills are not active or
copied.

Local modifications adapt invocation metadata and reconcile the workflows with
NFC firmware-safety rules, canonical documentation, branch policy, verification
gates, and explicit external-state authority.
